content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients have a diagnosis of endometriosis?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id, concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%endometriosis%'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, concept_name
LIMIT 50;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 433527
);

24,063 patients have a diagnosis of endometriosis.
